visual_gate.reason: REFramework exposes no supported Lua API for opening its own menu. External Insert and pointer injection cannot be advanced from a sent-input event alone: game-native dialogs, title transitions and first-click focus can consume the event. The bounded attempts were stopped instead of clicking unknown game UI.
visual_gate.minimum_user_action: Press Insert once after reaching a stable game scene; screenshot capture and inspection can then continue without quest or combat input.

screenshots.meaning: Deployed runtime at startup; REFramework menu visible before game-native startup flow completed.
A later startup sample showing the REFramework menu and Script Generated UI entry before title transition.
